tools.name: search
tools.description: Search 500+ checked Mac, iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch apps by name or by what you want to do (for example "clipboard manager for Mac" or "free habit tracker"). Returns matching apps with a listing link. Use fetch with an id for the full verdict and price.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full details for 1 app (verdict, who it is for, who should skip it, every price, where to buy, alternatives, any current deal) or 1 best-of guide. The id comes from search (an app slug such as "raycast", or "guide:clipboard").

tools.name: find_apps
tools.description: Find apps for a job with filters for device and pricing. Returns up to 20 apps, each with a 1-line verdict, who it suits, who should skip it, the exact price and a link.

tools.name: best_apps
tools.description: The ranked best-of guide for a category, winner first, for example clipboard, launcher, windows, notes, calendar, focus, habits, sleep, photos, pdf, backup, budgeting (money) or games. Leave category empty to list all 40 categories.

tools.name: app_deals
tools.description: Current Mac and iPhone app discounts checked by The Useful Apps, with codes and end dates. Optionally filter by app name or job.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
